summary: Planted change c43-plant (SPEC3 F9; never merged: orch/automerge.sh refuses rbd-plant PRs): pricing Quote: +4 ms CPU spin (mechanism spin; placement: top of Quote, before its first statement: every call (before any cache lookup or early return)). Intended effect: +4 ms of CPU per call of Quote on an idle core (more wall time on a contended CPU or under the pod's CPU quota). The registered dose is the A/B-measured own-time delta of pricing, not this knob.
